blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.
blocks.zh: 基因视频压缩(GVC)方法通常采用解码器侧传播模型,根据基因前传重建信号. 此外,这些方法大多在潜在空间而不是直接在像素域中进行去诺. 在本文中,我们提出ResGVC,作为GVC的剩余编码框架,通过发送剩余信号来引导对原创图片的称呼. ResGVC首先将原始图片编码在一个学习到的视频编码器内,然后将编码重建与原始图片之间的扭曲分解成一个剩余片段的序列,在每个解密步骤中每个剩余片段都在此获得. 残留的片段可以进一步通过以扩散变压器作为 en模型的新型残留编码器进行压缩. 与先前的方法不同,ResGVC在整个解码过程中引入了明确的源限制,而不是仅仅依赖解码器侧生成. 基于扩散的乙烯基模型还能够根据强大的遗传学前科建立更有效的分布模型。 此外,直接在像素空间中发号施令可避免潜在表达瓶颈造成的不可逆转的信息损失。 实验结果显示,与之前最先进的方法相比,ResGVC分别实现了LPIPS和PSNR的63.7%和83.8%的BD率降低,同时也提供了更高的视觉质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Traditional video coding standards ( Wiegand et al., 2003 ; Sullivan et al., 2012 ; Bross et al., 2021 ) and recent neural video compression (NVC) methods ( Li et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ) have shown non-trivial improvements in rate-distortion performance. As the optimization prioritizes signal fidelity, these codecs may lose fine textures or produce blurry results at low bitrates, which deviates from human perception. This limitation has motivated generative video compression (GVC), where generative models are integrated into codecs to synthesize plausible details that are not explicitly transmitted.
Recent GVC methods commonly employ decoder-side diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) to denoise reconstructed signals and improve perceptual quality ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ) . Moreover, most work performs denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain.
blocks.zh:
传统视频编码标准 (Wiegand等人,2003年;Sullivan等人,2012年;Bross等人,2021年)和近代神经视频压缩(NVC)方法(Li等人,2021年;Li等人,2024年;Jia等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年c)显示速率分解性能的非三角性改善. 由于优化优先考虑信号忠贞性,这些解码器可能会失去精细的纹理或者在低比特率下产生模糊的结果,这偏离了人类的认知. 这种限制激发了基因视频压缩(GVC),将基因模型集成到编码器中,以合成未明确传输的可信细节.
近期的GVC方法通常采用解码器侧扩散模型(Rombach等人,2022年;Yang等人,2025年;Wan等人,2025年),用于重塑信号并提高知觉质量(Ma和Chen,2025年a;Xue等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年d). 此外,大多数工作是在潜在空间而不是直接在像素域进行去名化。

blocks.en: However, in existing GVC methods, the decoder-side denoising process is largely driven by generative priors without sufficient source constraints along the denoising path. As a result, the denoised signal may drift from the original signal during iterative denoising. Besides, because these methods typically perform latent denoising coupled with latent autoencoders, the bottleneck discards fine details that cannot be reliably recovered at the decoder ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) . These limitations suggest that faithful GVC requires explicit source constraints throughout denoising and performs denoising directly in pixel space without relying on latent autoencoders.
blocks.zh: 然而,在现有的GVC方法中,解码方解码过程主要是由基因前科驱动的,沿解码路径没有充足的源限制. 因此,在迭代脱诺过程中,去声信号可能会从原始信号中漂移. 此外,由于这些方法通常具有潜在的解密作用,再加上潜在的自动编码器,瓶颈会丢弃在解码器中无法可靠地回收的精细细节(Kingma and Welling, 2013). 这些限制表明,忠实的GVC要求在整个对像素空间进行调试和直接进行调试时明确源限制,而不依赖潜在的自动编码器。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose ResGVC , a Res idual coding framework for high-fidelity G enerative V ideo C ompression, which guides diffusion denoising toward the original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then reformulates the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments. Each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step along a predefined denoising path at the encoder side. ResGVC selectively transmits fidelity-critical residual segments, which serve as source constraints for reconstructing the denoising path at the decoder side. Besides, our denoising is performed directly in pixel space, thereby avoiding the irreversible information loss introduced by latent autoencoders.

blocks.en: For efficient residual coding, we propose a residual codec by extending a pixel-space video diffusion transformer from a generator to a conditional probability estimator. This diffusion model estimates the distribution of each residual segment, allowing fidelity-critical residual segments to be entropy-coded while predicting the remaining residual segments from the previously transmitted ones. Thus, residual coding is reserved for information that must be faithfully transmitted to preserve reconstruction quality, whereas residual generation is employed for content that can be well predicted by the generative model to reduce bitrate. By jointly applying residual coding and residual generation along the denoising path, ResGVC achieves an improved perception-fidelity-rate trade-off.
blocks.zh: 为了高效的剩余编码,我们提议通过将像素空间的视频扩散变压器从生成器延伸至有条件的概率估计器来进行剩余编码. 这种扩散模型估计了每个残余部分的分布,使得忠心关键残余部分能够被编码,同时预测了以前传输的残余部分的剩余部分. 因此,剩余编码只用于必须忠实传递的信息,以保持重建质量,而剩余生成则用于基因模型能够很好地预测的内容,以减少比特率。 ResGVC通过在去诺化路径上联合应用残余编码和剩余生成,实现了感知-忠诚-率的更好的权衡.

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to explore residual coding in GVC and to repurpose a diffusion model for distribution modeling in both residual coding and residual generation. Experiments demonstrate that ResGVC achieves state-of-the-art compression performance across multiple metrics. Compared with the latest GVC method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while producing superior visual results.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这项工作是首先在GVC中探索残余编码,并重新使用扩散模型在残余编码和残余生成中进行分配。 实验证明ResGVC实现了跨多个度量衡的先进压缩性能. 与最新的GVC方法相比,ResGVC分别实现了LPIPS和PSNR的63.7%和83.8%的BD率降低,同时产生优异的视觉效果.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides diffusion denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residuals. It decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into residual segments, which can be transmitted to introduce explicit source constraints across different denoising steps. • We design a novel residual codec with a pixel-space video diffusion transformer as an entropy model. This diffusion model is capable of effective distribution modeling for residual signals, enabling entropy coding for selectively transmitted residual segments while preserving generative capability for non-transmitted ones. • Compared with existing methods, ResGVC achieves superior compression performance in terms of both perception quality and signal fidelity, while delivering better visual quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Generative Video Compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 基因视频压缩

blocks.en: Generative video compression (GVC) incorporates generative models into codecs to improve perceptual quality beyond the signal-fidelity objective of traditional video coding and fidelity-oriented NVC. Early GVC methods ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Mentzer et al., 2022 ) mainly introduced generative adversarial networks (GANs) and perceptual losses into neural codecs. Although these methods improved perceptual realism, they often suffered from training instability and visual artifacts. Other work explored generative reconstruction on latent or tokenized representations. For example, GLC-Video ( Qi et al., 2025 ) performed compression in latent space of a vector-quantized variational autoencoder, while ProGVC ( Li et al., 2026b ) proposed a progressive generative codec based on hierarchical multi-scale residual token maps. However, these methods remained constrained by the representational capacity of their latent or tokenized bottlenecks.
blocks.zh: 基因视频压缩(GVC)将基因模型整合到编码器中,以超越传统视频编码和以忠诚为导向的NVC的信号-真实性目标,提高知觉质量. 早期的GVC方法(Yang等人,2022年;Mentzer等人,2022年)主要将基因对抗网络(GANs)和知觉损失引入神经编码器. 虽然这些方法提高了知觉现实主义,但往往受到训练不稳定和视觉文物的影响. 其他工作探索了在潜在或象征性表述上进行基因重建。 例如,GLC-Video(Qi等人,2025年)在矢量化变异自编码器的潜在空间中进行了压缩,而ProGVC(Li等人,2026年b)则提出了基于分级多尺度剩余符号图的渐进基因编码. 然而,这些方法仍受到潜在或象征性瓶颈的代表性能力的限制。

blocks.en:
Recently, emerging diffusion models provide strong generative priors for GVC due to their ability to synthesize realistic spatial and temporal details. Existing diffusion-based methods ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026a ; Ma and Chen, 2025b ; Ma and Chen, 2026 ) typically adopt a latent compression pipeline, where the original video is encoded into a
compact latent representation and a diffusion model is employed in the decoder to remove compression distortions from the decoded latent. DiffVC ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ) follows this paradigm by compressing videos in the latent domain and using an image diffusion model to enhance decoded latent frames. GNVC-VD ( Mao et al., 2026 ) further introduces a video diffusion transformer to jointly enhance decoded latent representations. YODA ( Li et al., 2026d ) explores one-step diffusion-based video compression by embedding multiscale temporal reference features for both latent coding and latent denoising.

blocks.en: Despite their promising perceptual quality, these methods still primarily perform decoder-side denoising in latent space. Their denoising process is largely guided by generative priors, while explicit source constraints along the denoising path remain weak. Moreover, when built upon latent autoencoders, they inherit an irreversible reconstruction bottleneck that discards fine details. In contrast, our method introduces residual coding into pixel-space denoising, enabling explicit source constraints on the denoising process.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些方法具有很有希望的感知质量,但它们仍然主要在潜在空间中进行解码器侧消音。 他们的去名过程主要受基因前科指导,而去名路径上明确的源限制仍然薄弱. 此外,如果建立在潜在的自动编码器上,它们就会继承一个不可逆转的重建瓶颈,丢弃细微的细节。 与此相反,我们的方法将剩余编码引入像素空间去诺化,从而能够对去诺化过程作出明确的源限制.

blocks.en: 2.2 Diffusion Model with Flow Matching
blocks.zh: 2.2 带有流量匹配的传播模式

blocks.en: Diffusion models have become a popular paradigm for visual generation because they progressively transform noisy samples into clean data using learned denoising dynamics ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021a ; Song et al., 2021b ) . Recent work has developed diffusion architectures based on U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) and transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) backbones for high-quality image and video generation ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . To improve efficiency, many methods ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) perform denoising in a compressed latent space which is produced by a variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) . While this design substantially reduces computation, it inherits the reconstruction bottleneck of the autoencoder. In contrast, pixel-space diffusion models directly denoise visual signals in the original signal space and can better preserve fine-grained details ( Li and He, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 传播模型已成为视觉生成的流行范例,因为这些模型利用学到的去诺化动力学,逐渐将吵闹的样品转化为清洁数据(Ho等人,2020年;Song等人,2021a); Song et al., 2021b ) (中文(简体) ). 最近的工作发展了基于U-Net(Ronneberger等人,2015年)和变压器(Vaswani等人,2017年)的传播架构,用于高质量图像和视频生成(Peebles and Xie,2023年;Wan等人,2025年). 为了提高效率,许多方法(Rombach等人,2022年;Ma等人,2024年)在由变异自编码器(VAE)产生的压缩潜伏空间中进行去诺(Kingma and Welling,2013年)。 虽然这种设计大大降低了计算,但它继承了自动编码器的重建瓶颈. 相比之下,像素-空间传播模型直接在原始信号空间中凹凸的视觉信号,可以更好地保存精细的纹理细节(Li and He, 2026;Wang等人, 2026;Yu等人, 2026;Ma等人, 2026).

blocks.en: In GVC, diffusion models using flow matching are mainly employed as decoder-side denoisers to refine reconstructed latent representations with generative priors ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026a ; Ma and Chen, 2025b ) . Under this formulation, restoration can be considered as estimating a denoising path from the codec reconstruction toward the original pictures. Existing methods primarily predict the denoising path from generative priors, without sufficient source constraints. This motivates our design: instead of treating the denoising path as purely generative, we use transmitted residual signals to guide the denoising process, thereby constraining it with explicit source information. Moreover, unlike latent-space diffusion used in most prior methods, our approach performs denoising in pixel space without the latent representation bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 在GVC中,使用流量匹配的传播模型主要用作解码器-侧脱码器,用基因前兆来完善重建的潜在表达(Ma和Chen,2025a); Mao等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年d;Li等人,2026年a;Ma and Chen,2025年b。 根据这种提法,恢复可被视为估计从编码重建到原始图片的去名路径。 现有方法主要预测从基因前科中去名的路径,没有充足的来源限制. 这激励了我们的设计:我们不是把去诺的路径当作纯粹的基因,而是使用传播的剩余信号来引导去诺的过程,从而用明确的源信息来约束它. 此外,与大多数前期方法所使用的潜在空间扩散不同,我们的方法是在像素空间中去除隐形代表瓶颈。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: ResGVC represents a residual coding framework for high-fidelity GVC. It first compresses original pictures within a learned video codec ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and then refines the decoded pictures using residual information through iterative residual coding. The whole diffusion process is performed directly in pixel domain, avoiding the irreversible bottleneck of latent space. Concretely, the distortion between the decoded pictures and the original pictures is decomposed into a sequence of residual segments, each obtained at a denoising step. To encode these segments efficiently, we design a residual codec in which a pixel-space video diffusion model serves as a conditional probability estimator for entropy coding. Section 3.1 formulates the residual segments from the codec reconstruction to the original pictures. Section 3.2 presents the proposed residual codec and its diffusion-based entropy model. Section 3.3 describes a skip mode for residual coding, which skips residual coding at selected denoising steps and replaces it with decoder-side residual generation for reducing bitrate.
blocks.zh: ResGVC代表高纯度GVC的剩余编码框架. 它首先在学习到的视频编码器(Li et al., 2026c)内压缩原始图片,然后通过迭代剩余编码来精炼解码图片. 整个扩散过程直接在像素域中进行,避免了潜在空间的不可逆转的瓶颈. 具体地说,解码的图片与原始图片之间的扭曲被分解成一个剩余片段的序列,每个片段都是在解码步骤中获得的. 为了有效地编码这些段,我们设计了一个剩余编码器,其中像素-空间视频传播模型充当了肽编码的有条件概率估计器. 第3.1节规定了从编码重建到原始图片的剩余部分。 第3.2节介绍了拟议的残余编码器及其扩散基式乙烯模型。 第3.3节描述了剩余编码的跳转模式,该模式在选定的去诺化步骤中跳过剩余编码,代之以解码器侧余生成,以降低比特率.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 shows the proposed residual codec which consists of a residual encoder (ResEnC) and a residual decoder (ResDeC), with a shared diffusion-based entropy model implemented by a video pixel diffusion transformer (VideoPiT). Therefore, 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} can be used at the encoder side to construct the next residual segment according to Eq. 6 , while simulating the decoder-side reconstructed denoising process. blocks.en: ResGVC supports a skip mode, in which residual coding is applied only to selected denoising steps. For the skipped steps, the corresponding residual segments are not transmitted but are instead generated at the decoder without incurring additional bitrate or quantization error, as illustrated in Fig. 4 . Specifically, each residual segment 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} can be recovered at the decoder in one of two modes: residual coding , in which 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} is reconstructed from the bitstream, and residual generation , in which 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} is predicted by the diffusion model, i.e. , VideoPiT. Residual coding is employed in the earlier denoising steps, which are more crucial to the final reconstruction quality, to faithfully transmit fidelity-critical residual segments. In the later steps, by leveraging the informative context from previously decoded residual signals, VideoPiT serves as a generator to estimate 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} and 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} without bitstream constraints. The estimated 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} is directly used as the predicted 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} , while 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} is discarded. Therefore, given a total of T T denoising steps, the number of residual-coding steps determines the trade-off between bitrate and reconstruction quality, and its effect is further analyzed in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: ResGVC支持跳过模式,其中剩余编码仅适用于选定的去诺步骤. 对于跳过的步骤,如图所示,相应的剩余段不传输,而是在解码器中生成,而不会发生额外的比特率或量化错误。 4 (英语). 具体来说,每个残段R ^ t\ mathbf{R}}_{t}可以在解码器中以两种模式之一恢复: 残段编码,其中R ^ t\ mathbf{R}}_{t}是从位流重建的; 残段生成,其中R ^ t\ mathbf{R}}_{t}是通过扩散模型预言的,即VideoPiT. 残段编码在较早的解码步骤中采用,这对最终重建质量更为关键,以忠实地传输忠心-关键残段. 在以后的步骤中,VideoPiT通过利用先前解码的剩余信号的信息背景,充当一个生成器来估算μ t\bm\mu}_{t}和\ t\bm\sigma}_{t}而不受位流限制. 估计的 μ t\bm\ mu}_{t} 直接用作预测的 ^ t\ hat\ mathbf{R}}_{t} , 而\ bm\ sigma}_{t} 则被丢弃 。 因此,鉴于共有T T 解码步骤,剩余编码步骤的数量决定了比特率与重建质量之间的权衡,并在第4.3节中进一步分析其效果.

blocks.en: Training details. ResGVC is trained on the OpenVid-1M dataset ( Nan et al., 2025 ) with a rate-distortion loss function, i.e. , L = R + λ ​ D L=R+\lambda D . R R denotes the total bitrate cost from the learned video codec and the proposed residual codec. D D denotes the reconstruction distortion, computed as the sum of L2 loss, LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and DISTS ( Ding et al., 2020 ) . To evaluate compression performance at multiple bitrates, we train four independent models with trade-off parameter λ \lambda sampled at four points by linear interpolation in logarithmic space over the range [0.025, 2.5]. Each model is trained with a GOP size of 8. T T is set to 5, indicating that five denoising steps are performed under the noise scheduler from Wan et al. (2025) to determine σ t \sigma_{t} . The detailed training strategies are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 培训详情。 ResGVC在OpenVid-1M数据集(Nan等人,2025年)上接受训练,具有速率扭曲损失函数,即L = R + + + + D L = R + lambda D. R 表示从学到的视频编码器和拟议的剩余编码器得出的总比特率成本。 DD表示重建扭曲,计算为L2损失,LPIPS(张等人,2018年)和DISTS(丁等人,2020年)之和. 为了在多个比特速率下评价压缩性能,我们用权衡参数QQ\\lambda在四点上通过线性插值对数空间在范围[0.025,2.5]中抽取的4个独立模型. 每个型号的训练采用GOP尺寸为8. T T被设定为5,表示在Wan等人(2025年)的噪声排程器下进行5个除音步骤,以确定\ t\sigma_{t}. 详细的培训战略载于附录。

blocks.en: Test details. We evaluate ResGVC on the HEVC B ( Sullivan et al., 2012 ) , UVG ( Mercat et al., 2020 ) , and MCL-JCV ( Wang et al., 2016 ) datasets. Following ( Li et al., 2023 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) , raw YUV420 videos are converted to RGB using BT.709 ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and the first 96 frames of each sequence are used for evaluation. Compression performance is measured by BD-rate and BD-metric ( Bjontegaard, 2001 ) . Signal fidelity is measured by PSNR and MS-SSIM ( Wang et al., 2003 ) . Perceptual quality is assessed by LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and DISTS ( Ding et al., 2020 ) . To assess temporal perceptual consistency, we report FloLPIPS ( Danier et al., 2022 ) , a flow-guided LPIPS variant. Generative realism is measured by FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , following ( Mentzer et al., 2020 ) . Bitrate is reported in bits per pixel (BPP). ResGVC is evaluated with intra-period = -1 and GOP size = 8. Since ResGVC is trained with five denoising steps, we use two steps for residual coding and three steps for residual generation during testing, which gives the best overall compression performance. Analysis of this setting is provided in Section 4.3 .

ResGVC以周期内= -1和GOP大小=8. 由于ResGVC经过了5个调试步骤的培训,我们在测试时使用2个步骤进行剩余编码,3个步骤进行剩余生成,这给出了最佳的总体压缩性能. 第4.3节分析了这一背景。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare ResGVC with three categories of baselines: 1)
the traditional video codec VTM-17.0 ( Bross et al., 2021 ) ; 2) the fidelity-oriented NVC method DCVC-FM ( Li et al., 2024 ) ; and 3) GVC methods, including PLVC ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , GLC-Video ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , DiffVC ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ) , GNVC-VD ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , and YODA ( Li et al., 2026d ) . For VTM-17.0, we follow the evaluation protocol from Li et al. (2023) . Since the code for DiffVC and GNVC-VD is publicly unavailable, we report the results from their original papers. Other baselines are tested with their default settings. We use the latest open-source method YODA as the anchor for BD-rate computation, rather than VTM-17.0 as usual, because the RD curves of VTM-17.0 are often far from those of GVC methods and overlap only marginally in quality range.

blocks.en: Quantitative comparisons. Fig. 5 shows the rate-perception curves on the three test sets.

blocks.en:
The proposed ResGVC outperforms all baselines on most perceptual metrics, achieving notably lower LPIPS and FID at comparable bitrates. Table 1 summarizes the BD-rate and BD-metric results. Averaged over the three test sets, ResGVC achieves bitrate savings of 63.7% in LPIPS, 21.2% in DISTS, 67.2% in FID, and 26.1% in FloLPIPS relative to the second-best method YODA. Additionally, as shown in Fig. 6 , ResGVC delivers the best PSNR and MS-SSIM performance among all GVC methods, and is even comparable to the fidelity-oriented NVC method DCVC-FM at low bitrates.
Notably, on the HEVC B test set, ResGVC surpasses DCVC-FM in MS-SSIM when the bitrate is below 0.005 BPP. Detailed BD-rate and BD-metric results for PSNR and MS-SSIM are provided in the appendix. Overall, these results show that ResGVC advances both perceptual quality and signal fidelity over previous GVC methods.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparisons. Fig. 7 presents a visual comparison of different methods. Owing to its optimization objective that prioritizes signal fidelity, DCVC-FM tends to produce blurred regions and fails to preserve fine-grained textures and structural details. Although GVC methods such as GLC-Video and YODA achieve higher perceptual quality than DCVC-FM, they often introduce spatial inconsistencies and hallucinated details, reflecting an overemphasis on perceptual quality at the expense of signal fidelity. By contrast, ResGVC more faithfully preserves object structures while maintaining rich textural details. These observations further suggest that, for GVC methods, signal fidelity should not be neglected when optimizing perceptual quality; otherwise, noticeable visual degradation and structural collapse may occur.
blocks.zh: 定性比较. 图7对不同方法进行了直观比较。 由于DCVC-FM的优化目标以信号忠贞为主,它往往产生模糊的区域,未能保存精细的纹理和结构细节. 虽然GLC-Video和YODA等GVC方法的知觉质量比DCVC-FM更高,但它们经常引入空间不一致和幻觉细节,反映出过度强调知觉质量而牺牲信号忠贞. 相比之下,ResGVC更忠实地保存对象结构,同时保持丰富的纹理细节. 这些意见进一步表明,对于全球价值链方法而言,在优化认知质量时,不应忽视信号忠贞性;否则,可能会出现明显的视觉退化和结构崩溃。

blocks.en: Complexity comparisons. We compare the per-frame encoding and decoding times of ResGVC with those of two recent methods, i.e. , GNVC-VD and YODA. Among the GVC baselines, GNVC-VD delivers superior compression performance on fidelity-oriented metrics, whereas YODA excels on perceptual metrics. Since the official implementation of GNVC-VD is unavailable, we reproduce its model architecture solely for complexity evaluation, without training. As presented in Table 3 , ResGVC is faster than GNVC-VD in both encoding and decoding, mainly because GNVC-VD has a substantially larger model size. Compared with YODA, which uses single-step denoising, ResGVC has a slightly slower decoding speed due to its five-step denoising design. However, the compact model size of ResGVC helps offset the overhead introduced by the additional denoising steps, allowing it to maintain competitive decoding speed. Despite using fewer parameters, ResGVC still outperforms YODA in both perceptual quality and signal fidelity, further demonstrating the effectiveness of our pixel-space residual coding framework.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.3 违约

blocks.en: We conduct a series of ablation studies to verify the effect of key designs in the proposed ResGVC. All BD-rate results are averaged on three test sets.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一系列消毒研究,以核实拟议ResGVC中关键设计的效果. 所有BD率的结果平均在三套测试中进行.

blocks.en: Effect of pixel-space residual coding. ResGVC performs residual coding directly in pixel space. To validate this design, we conduct the ablations in Table 3 , using the variant with five-step pixel-space residual coding as the anchor. Removing residual coding causes a substantial performance degradation, which confirms the necessity of residual coding. We then shift residual coding from pixel space to latent space by inserting ResGVC between the VAE encoder and decoder of Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , whose implementation details are provided in the appendix. This variant incurs 17.4% and 28.6% BD-rate losses in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, demonstrating that residual coding is more effective in pixel space than in latent space.
blocks.zh: 像素空间剩余编码的效果. ResGVC直接在像素空间中执行剩余编码. 为了验证这个设计,我们用以五步像素-空间剩余编码为锚的变体在表3中进行调试. 消除剩余编码会导致性能大幅退化,这证实了剩余编码的必要性. 然后,我们通过在Wan2.1(Wan等人,2025年)的VAE编码器和解码器之间插入ResGVC, 将剩余编码从像素空间转移到潜在空间,其实施细节载于附录。 该变体分别发生LPIPS和PSNR的BD率损失17.4%和28.6%,表明剩余编码在像素空间比在潜在空间更有效.

blocks.en: Effect of diffusion-based entropy model. Existing fidelity-oriented NVC and GVC methods typically rely on CNN-based entropy models to estimate the distributions used for entropy coding. In contrast, ResGVC adopts a diffusion-based entropy model, which leverages stronger generative priors for more accurate conditional probability estimation. As shown in Table 3 , replacing our entropy model with the latest CNN-based design ( Li et al., 2026c ) degrades performance across all metrics, confirming the advantage of the diffusion-based entropy model for residual coding.
blocks.zh: 基于扩散的py模型的效果. 现有的面向忠诚的NVC和GVC方法一般依靠基于CNN的Entropy模型来估计用于Entropy编码的分布. 相比之下,ResGVC采用了一种基于扩散的py模型,利用更强的基因前科来进行更准确的有条件概率估计. 如表3所示,用最新的基于CNN的设计(Li等人,2026c)来取代我们的py模型,降解了所有度量衡的性能,证实了基于扩散的 en模型对剩余编码的优势.

blocks.zh: 表 4: BD 率(%)\\\ 不同跳过设置下对剩余编码的下限比较。 “RC”和“RG”分别表示残余编码和残余生成。

blocks.en: Effect of the skip mode for residual coding. In ResGVC, residual coding can be skipped at selected denoising steps, where residual segments are instead generated at the decoder by the diffusion model. This skip mode enables flexible switching between residual coding and residual generation at different denoising steps to optimize rate-distortion performance. As presented in Table 4 , we fix the total number of denoising steps to five and vary the number of residual-coding steps from zero to five, with the remaining steps handled by residual generation. The best performance is achieved with two coding steps and three generation steps, indicating that the most fidelity-critical residual segments are transmitted in the first two steps. Using more coding steps degrades performance by spending additional bitrate on residuals that can be reliably predicted from generative priors at the decoder, while using fewer coding steps weakens source constraints and thus reduces reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 剩余编码的跳过模式的效果 。 在ResGVC中,剩余编码可以在选定的解码步骤中跳过,在扩散模型的解码器中生成剩余段. 这种跳转模式可以在不同的去诺步骤下灵活地切换剩余编码和剩余生成,以优化速率扭曲性能. 如表4所示,我们把除号步骤的总数固定在5个,并将残余编码步骤的数目从0个改为5个,其余步骤由残余生成者处理。 最佳表现是通过两个编码步骤和三个生成步骤实现的,表明最忠诚的关键残余部分在前两个步骤中传递. 使用更多的编码步骤会通过将额外的比特率花在剩余物上来降解性能,这些比特率可以在解码器上从基因前科中可靠地预测出来,同时使用更少的编码步骤会削弱源的制约,从而降低重建质量.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present ResGVC, a residual coding framework for generative video compression that guides diffusion denoising toward the original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures with a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments over denoising steps. These residual segments can further by compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model, enabling explicit source constraints to be introduced throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. By denoising directly in pixel space, ResGVC also avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results demonstrate that ResGVC achieves state-of-the-art compression performance, reducing BD-rate by 63.7% in LPIPS and 83.8% in PSNR compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, while also delivering superior visual quality.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了ResGVC,这是基因视频压缩的剩余编码框架,它通过传输剩余信号来引导向原始图片的传播。 ResGVC首先用学习到的视频解码器对原始图片进行编码,然后将编码重建与原始图片之间的扭曲分解成一个剩余段的序列,而不是去诺化步骤. 这些残留部分还可以通过用新的残留编码器压缩,将扩散变压器作为py模型,从而在整个去诺化过程中能够引入明确的源限制,而不是仅依靠解码器侧生成. 通过直接在像素空间中发音,ResGVC也避免了潜在表达瓶颈造成的不可逆转的信息损失. 实验结果显示ResGVC实现了最先进的压缩性能,与之前最先进的方法相比,LPIPS的BD率降低了63.7%,PSNR降低了83.8%,同时也提供了更高的视觉质量.

blocks.en: Analysis Transform and Synthesis Transform. The proposed residual codec employs analysis transform g a g_{\mathrm{a}} and synthesis transform g s g_{\mathrm{s}} to reduce the redundancy within each residual segment. g a g_{\mathrm{a}} and g s g_{\mathrm{s}} are built upon the encoder and decoder architecture of the inter model in DCVC-UF HT-L ( Li et al., 2026c ) , with two principal distinctions. First, our g a g_{\mathrm{a}} and g s g_{\mathrm{s}} are shared by both intra-coding and inter-coding, with the adapter introduced for the intra-frame to align the input channels of g a g_{\mathrm{a}} . By contrast, DCVC-UF employs two separate models for intra- and inter-coding. Second, we employ the previously reconstructed GOP 𝐱 ^ 0 p \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0}^{\mathrm{p}} as condition information, whereas DCVC-UF relies on memory updated using features from decoded frames.

blocks.en: Diffusion-based Entropy Model. In our framework, the video pixel diffusion transformer (VideoPiT) serves as an entropy model, in which each PiT block is built upon the T2I variant of PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . We employ the previously reconstructed GOP 𝐱 ^ 0 p \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0}^{\mathrm{p}} as the conditioning input, whereas PixelDiT conditions on features derived from the text embedding. In VideoPiT, the input 𝐱 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{t} first undergoes 16 × 16 16\times 16 patchification, followed by six PiT blocks. The output feature of the final PiT block is linearly projected to produce the probability parameters 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} and 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} for entropy coding. Notably, both 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} and 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} have spatial dimensions downsampled by a factor of 16 relative to 𝐱 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{t} .

blocks.en: Stage 3. We progressively scale the number of denoising steps, i.e. , T T , from 1 to 5. blocks.en: A.4.1 Employing our framework in pixel space vs. latent space
blocks.zh: A.4.1 联合国 在像素空间与潜在空间中使用我们的框架

blocks.en: The proposed ResGVC is employed in pixel space rather than in latent space produced by autoencoders commonly adopted in previous GVC methods. In Section 4.3 , we conduct an ablation study in which residual coding is instead performed in latent space by inserting ResGVC between the VAE encoder and decoder. Here, we provide the implementation details.
blocks.zh: 拟议的ResGVC用于像素空间,而不是由以前GVC方法中常用的自动编码器产生的潜在空间. 在第4.3节中,我们进行一项消毒研究,通过在VAE编码器和解码器之间插入ResGVC,在潜在空间进行剩余编码。 在这里,我们提供了执行的细节。

blocks.en: Following ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , we adopt the VAE from Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) as the autoencoder, which performs 8 × 8\times spatial downsampling for all frames and 4 × 4\times temporal downsampling for inter-frames only. As described in Section 3.2 , g a g_{\mathrm{a}} transforms the to-be-encoded 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} into 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} for subsequent entropy coding. The spatial resolution of 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} is reduced by a factor of 16 relative to 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} through an 8 × 8 8\times 8 patchification and a convolutional layer with 2 × 2\times downsampling within g a g_{\mathrm{a}} . To shift ResGVC to latent space, we encode two latent frames into 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} , corresponding to eight frames as a GOP in pixel space, and remove the patchification to ensure that 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} retains the same dimensions as in pixel-space residual coding. Besides, 16 × 16 16\times 16 patchification in the VideoPiT is replaced with 2 × 2 2\times 2 patchification.

blocks.en: We provide additional experimental results in Table 6 to evaluate the effectiveness of performing residual coding and residual generation in latent space vs. pixel space. A comparison between line (a) and line (b) shows that when five-step residual coding is performed in latent space, compression performance declines, particularly in terms of BD-rate w.r.t. PSNR. By contrast, comparing line (c) with line (d), the latent-space variant outperforms the pixel-space counterpart on perceptual metrics, i.e. , LPIPS, DISTS, and FloLPIPS. This may indicate that under a fixed model capacity, compact residual latent representations are more amenable to generation than pixel-space signals. Comparing line (a) with line (c), both of which operate in latent space, residual generation proves considerably more tractable than residual coding. This might be because compact latent representations are more susceptible to quantization, while quantization errors in latent space may be magnified in pixel space by the VAE decoder. Overall, as evidenced by the comparison between line (e) and line (f), the pixel-space model surpasses the latent-space model under our default setting of two-step coding and three-step generation.
blocks.zh: 我们在表6中提供了额外的实验结果,以评估在潜在空间对像素空间中进行剩余编码和剩余生成的有效性。 对(a)项和(b)项的比较表明,当在潜在空间中进行五步剩余编码时,压缩性能会下降,特别是在BD率w.r.t.PSNR方面。 相比之下,将(c)行与(d)行相比较,潜在的空间变体在感知度量上,即LPIPS、DISTS和FloLPIPS上比对像素-空间的对应体表现得更好。 这可能表明,在固定的模型能力下,紧凑的残余潜在表示比像素-空间信号更容易产生。 将(a)线与(c)线相比较,这两条线在潜在空间运行,残余生成比残余编码要容易操作得多。 这可能是因为紧凑的潜在表示比较容易被量化,而潜在空间中的量化错误可能由VAE解码器在像素空间中放大. 总体而言,从(e)行和(f)行的比较中可以看出,在我们默认设置两步编码和三步生成的情况下,像素空间模型超过了潜在空间模型。

Notably, as shown in Table 4 , taking our default setting (two residual-coding steps and three residual-generation steps) as the anchor, using five residual-coding steps leads to more than a 3% BD-rate increase under all metrics. This discrepancy may stem from the fact that residual coding in the later steps introduces quantization errors that degrade reconstruction quality, while the residuals generated by VideoPiT are already sufficiently accurate at these denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 表7列示了不同剩余编码步骤的比特率成本分布. 学习的视频编码器占总比特率的最大部分. 在剩余编码期间,步骤3,步骤4和步骤5的综合比特率贡献为总比特率的2.3%。 值得注意的是,如表4所示,以我们的默认设置(两个剩余编码步骤和三个剩余生成步骤)为锚点,使用五个剩余编码步骤,导致所有衡量标准下的BD率增长超过3%。 这种差异可能源于以下事实,即后期步骤中的剩余编码引入了可降解重建质量的量化错误,而VideoPiT产生的剩余部分在这些去名步骤上已经足够准确.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we provide a visual example produced with five-step residual coding to illustrate the distribution of bitrate cost across different steps and the corresponding variation in perceptual quality. As shown in Fig. 8 , the first two residual-coding steps consume the most bitrate and yield significant perceptual quality improvements. At step 3, step 4, and step 5, perceptual quality continues to improve through residual generation using predicted residual segments.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们提供了一个以五步剩余编码制成的视觉实例,以说明比特率成本在不同步骤之间的分布以及认知质量的相应变化。 如图8所示,前两个剩余编码步骤消耗的比特率最高,并产生显著的感知质量改进. 第3步,第4步和第5步,通过利用预测的残余区段产生残留物,视觉质量继续提高。

blocks.en: A.5 More Visual Examples
blocks.zh: A.5 更多视觉实例

blocks.en: We present additional qualitative comparisons on three datasets: HEVC B, MCL-JCV, and UVG. As illustrated in Fig. 9 - Fig. 11 , our method yields visually sharper and more realistic reconstructions than the competing baselines. Fig. 12 presents a comparison of temporal consistency across different methods. DCVC-FM generally produces blurry reconstructions, while GLC-Video and YODA tend to introduce jitter and flickering artifacts, thereby compromising temporal coherence. By contrast, our method delivers temporally stable reconstructions, especially in regions containing dense textures. These examples further underscore that our approach excels not only on quantitative metrics but also in preserving fine textures, realistic details, and perceptual naturalness, thereby delivering superior visual quality.
blocks.zh: 我们对三个数据集(HEVC B、MCL-JCV和UVG)提出了额外的定性比较。 如图9-图11所示,我们的方法比相互竞争的基线更明显、更现实的重建。 图12比较了不同方法的时间一致性。 DCVC-FM一般会产生模糊的重建,而GLC-Video和YODA则倾向于引入焦急和闪烁的文物,从而损害时间一致性. 相比之下,我们的方法可以进行时间上稳定的重建,特别是在有密集纹理的区域。 这些例子进一步突出表明,我们的做法不仅在定量衡量方面,而且在保存精细的纹理、现实的细节和知觉自然性方面都非常出色,从而提供了更高的视觉质量。
